results.content: # Crossing the Halfway Point: Aptamer-Based, Highly Multiplexed Assay for the Assessment of the Proteome Click to copy article linkArticle link copied! To overcome technical challenges associated with highly multiplexed measurements, we developed an affinity reagent-based method that uses aptamers with protein-like side chains along with an assay that takes advantage of their unique properties. Several proteomic platforms are currently in use to analyze proteins in complex biological matrices, including mass spectrometry (MS), (8−10);) affinity-based methods (antibodies and aptamers) (11−21);) and emerging technologies such as single-molecule protein sequencing and integrated, single-molecule proteome analysis. In sandwich-based proteomic analyses (e.g., enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay), a second antibody is used to enhance specificity through an independent binding event.
